QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: Other Investment Products_8

question.text: Which of the following entities is NOT eligible to open a PPF account?

answer.text: Individual with an existing savings bank account

explanation.text: The Logic: HUFs and NRIs cannot open PPF accounts. Only individual Indian residents can open PPF accounts — one for self and one on behalf of a minor child. The Trap: Minors CAN open PPF through a guardian (Option B is valid). The restriction is on HUFs and NRIs specifically. Cross-Exam Context: PPF eligibility is tested in Series XVII and X-A. Compare with NPS where NRIs and OCIs can open accounts.
